text:
diego.m: Morning all  first day. Unboxed MacBook Pro 16" (intel) asset RWI-1105. During setup the MDM partially applied but Okta SSO failed with 'unsupported OS version'. FileVault didn't escrow. Any advice?
it-support: Welcome Diego! Can you paste the macOS version from About This Mac and the output of `sw_vers -productVersion`?
diego.m: shows macOS 12.6.5, `sw_vers -productVersion` -> 12.6.5
it-support: That explains it. Our onboarding policies require macOS 13.0+ for the new Okta device flow and automatic FileVault escrow. Two options: 1) upgrade in place via App Store (preferred) or 2) we can provide a USB bootable installer if App Store access is blocked by Apple ID. Which do you have access to?
diego.m: I don't have an Apple ID on this machine. I can create one but didn't want to mix personal accounts. Can you provide the bootable?
mac-admin: We avoid shipping universal Apple IDs. We'll provide a signed macOS 13.6 installer DMG via our secure file server and instructions to create a bootable installer. Steps (short): download DMG -> mount -> `sudo /Volumes/Install\ macOS\ Ventura/Install\ macOS\ Ventura.app/Contents/Resources/createinstallmedia --volume /Volumes/USB` -> reboot while holding Option and install. I'll upload the file now and pre-approve the device in ABM.
diego.m: copying that command, thanks. How long does install take?
it-support: Plan ~30-45min for download+write and 20-30min for install depending on USB and hardware. Make sure you backup any local files.
mac-admin: DMG uploaded to secure link (internal): https://files.redwood.internal/mdm/installers/macos-13.6-rwi.dmg (expires 6 hours). Use a 16GB USB formatted as Mac OS Extended (Journaled). If you get stuck ping here with a screenshot.
diego.m: Downloading now. Quick Q: will I lose MDM enrollment if I reinstall?
it-support: If ABM assignment exists and we flagged asset RWI-1105, it should auto-enroll during Setup Assistant once you connect to Wi-Fi. I pre-assigned the token; you should see "Corporate device enrollment requested" during setup.
diego.m: USB creation finished, starting installer.
(40 minutes pass)
diego.m: Completed upgrade to 13.6 and reached desktop. No Apple ID signed in. I see a notification: "Corporate device enrollment requested". Clicked Accept -> redirected to Okta, completed SSO.
it-support: Check enrollment and FileVault status: `sudo profiles status -type enrollment` and `sudo fdesetup status`.
diego.m: `profiles: Enrolled via MDM (mdm.redwood.internal)` and `fdesetup: FileVault is Off`.
mac-admin: I see enrollment success on our console. I pushed the FileVault enable policy now; should prompt a modal to enable and escrow. If the modal doesn't appear, run `profiles renew -type enrollment` and reboot.
diego.m: Modal popped, chose to escrow to KMS. `sudo fdesetup status` -> FileVault On.
diego.m: One last thing: VS Code remote says it needs 'Endpoint Security' permission and it showed a System Settings prompt but I accidentally clicked deny earlier. How to allow?
dev-tools: Go to System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> Full Disk Access / Endpoint Security (depending on macOS) and enable 'Redwood Dev Agent' and 'Code Helper'. For the blocked extension, there should be an "Allow" button under General right after the install attempt; if not, re-run the agent installer from /Applications and try install again to re-trigger the allow.
diego.m: Found the Allow button under Privacy & Security > General and clicked it, then rebooted. VS Code Remote connects now.
mdm-bot: Notice: Enrollment completed and FileVault escrow confirmed for asset RWI-1105 at 2026-07-02T10:12:20Z.
diego.m: Huge thanks everyone, everything working. Adding to inventory note: serial C02A1ABC -> RWI-1105. Closing thread :raised_hands:
